definitions.gloss: extra charge; additional fee; separate charge
definitions.explanation: A fee that is not included in the base price and must be paid separately. Common in restaurants, hotels, and service industries.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドリンク→ドリンク：23507_dorinku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別料金|べつりょうきん}です。
Wi-Fi⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別料金|べつりょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれていない→含む：01982_fukumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{別料金|べつりょうきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Breakfast is not included in the plan, so there will be an additional charge.

notes:
A practical term frequently seen on menus, hotel listings, and service descriptions. Indicates that something costs extra beyond the standard price.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別料金|べつりょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ — an extra charge applies
- {別料金|べつりょうきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — to be charged separately
- {別料金|べつりょうきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ — for an additional fee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追加料金|ついかりょうきん}→追加料金：22313_tsuikaryoukin⟧: additional charge — very similar, but emphasizes that something is being added on top
- ⟦{有料|ゆうりょう}→有料：03178_yuuryou⟧: paid, not free — states that something costs money, without specifying that it is separate from another charge
